editorial:
Imagine waking up and realizing every single superhero in your world has been turned into a baby. That is exactly what happens when a mean monster named Miden decides to steal the memories and powers of the PreCure warriors. You get to follow Nagisa and Hana, the only two heroes left standing, as they try to fix this huge mess. The vibe is super colorful and upbeat, blending a lot of cute baby chaos with high-energy magic fights. It feels like a giant party where all your favorite characters show up, even if some of them are wearing diapers for a while.

What really works here is the pacing; it never feels slow because there is always something wild happening. The action scenes are bright and punchy, and the comedy comes naturally from the absurd situation. While the plot is pretty simple, the emotional heart of the story keeps you invested. If you have a family or just love cute animation, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: In the final showdown, Nagisa and Hana use the power of friendship and memories to defeat Miden. By remembering the bonds they shared, they break the spell and turn all the baby Cures back into their adult selves. The movie wraps up with a giant group hug and a celebration. Everyone gets their powers back, and the world is saved from the monster's sadness, leaving everyone happier and closer than before.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves magical girls and cute characters
